build_umbrella_chain_environment: build an UmbrellaChain environment with a specified chain length and number of distractor observations
create_observation_spec: create an observation spec returning an Array with shape based on distractor count
test_step_method: test the _step method to verify reward assignment at chain termination
review_reset_method: review the _reset method that randomizes need_umbrella and has_umbrella states
summarize_optimal_return_property: summarize the optimal_return property that returns the maximum achievable reward of 1
